latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-video-dataset 1.0.0:

- Generate labeled video datasets from CSV prompts and descriptions, supporting 720p output by default.
- Seamless workflow: upload text/video description pairs, generate, and export MP4 datasets in 2–5 minutes.
- Automatic backend connection and session management, including free starter credits for new users.
- Keyword/intent-based action routing for common dataset and export actions.
- Detailed error handling and format support for common video, audio, and image export types.
